name: Model Guidance
description: Injects model-specific execution guidance (GPT/Gemini) and memory/skill guidance into the agent system prompt.

injectMemoryGuidance.description: Inject MEMORY_GUIDANCE text into system prompt (default: true)

injectSkillsGuidance.description: Inject SKILLS_GUIDANCE text into system prompt (default: true)

injectSessionSearchGuidance.description: Inject SESSION_SEARCH_GUIDANCE — guide model to use session_search before asking user to repeat (default: true)
